reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that checkpoints pre-images from successful write/edit results and restores recent file mutations through a model tool or /rollback command.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 捕获文件写入或编辑前的内容，并通过模型工具或 /rollback 命令恢复最近的文件变更。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that captures pre-mutation contents from successful file writes or edits and restores recent changes through a model tool or the /rollback command.

capabilities: Observes successful write/edit results and stores file pre-images
Writes restored file contents directly to the workspace
Deletes files when restoring records for previously absent paths
Invokes the git executable for checkpointing and restoration
